name: Chelvin
backstory: Hemm, disguised as Harper Chelvin, is a Doppelganger posing as an elderly lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers. Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar, Chelvin was killed and impersonated some time ago.
